However both are the same PRIMARY TWO rank (rank_gap 0) and the source topic order (3D as Topic 1, 2D as Topic 2) does not substantiate a developmental 2D-to-3D dependency, so no directional buildsTowards is warranted. Shared LC/text tokens (chiefly 'identify') and source-page proximity are corroborating but not by themselves relationship-establishing. relatesTo best fits the meaningful reinforcement without asserted dependency.
